dogecoin.text: HT: the channel on the Zcash community chat devoted to praising the virtues of other coins. It's Dogecoin Day there.
Rare footage of Dogecoin mining rig. https://t.co/SRoCrkbwKg
My mom thinks Zcash is locked in a life and death struggle with Dogecoin for 20th place.

@CBarraford @ShapeShiftCOO @least_nathan @In4Crypto @Truthcoin @zecwallet @THORChain @zcashomg Again, not to under-estimate the difficulty (since engineering is always hard), but AFAICT you should be able to produce those golang libraries for Zcash taddresses just by copypastaing the golang library for Bitcoin, Litecoin, or Dogecoin and searching and replacing to "Zcash".
He said, so the only thing people do with Bitcoin and Dogecoin is just hold onto it until they cash out? I was like, yep. 🔚

He asked what’s the difference between Bitcoin and Dogecoin compared to Zcash. I said Zcash protects your privacy. With those others, any time you make a transaction, people can see your balance and all your other transactions. He was shocked! He said Really!? ⤵️
